completion_promises.criterion_text: Dedup map is first-wins with a 300s TTL, keyed `(event_type, build_id, stage_label or '')` for stream events and `('build_queued', correlation_id)` for the intake event (ASSUM-006).
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented `_make_dedup_key()` method that creates proper keys for stream events and build_queued events. Dedup map initialized in __init__ with 300s TTL constant. Test `TestQueuedIntakeDedupKeyedOnCorrelationId` verifies intake event keying.

completion_promises.criterion_text: TTL is measured with a monotonic clock (`time.monotonic()`), never wall clock; expired entries are evicted on insert.
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented `_evict_expired_dedup_entries()` using `time.monotonic()` for all time tracking. Eviction called from `notify()` before dedup check. Test `TestDedupTtlExpiry` verifies TTL expiry and eviction.

completion_promises.criterion_text: A duplicated terminal envelope (same event_type/build_id redelivered within 300s) posts to Slack exactly once.
completion_promises.evidence: Dedup logic in `notify()` checks dedup map before enqueueing, dropping duplicates with debug log. Test `TestDuplicateTerminalEnvelopePostsOnce` delivers same notification twice and asserts single chat_postMessage call.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Two distinct concurrent terminal events (different build_ids) both post, and each message contains only its own build's fields — no cross-contamination.
completion_promises.evidence: Dedup keys include build_id, so distinct build_ids create different keys. Test `TestDistinctConcurrentTerminalsBothPost` delivers two notifications with different build_ids and verifies both post with correct feature_ids.
Added `_WORKER_PACING_DELAY = 1.0` constant and `await asyncio.sleep(_WORKER_PACING_DELAY)` at end of worker loop after message delivery. Pacing happens in worker task, not in notify().

completion_promises.criterion_text: A 429 response honours `Retry-After`, retries within a bounded per-message retry budget, and on budget exhaustion logs WARNING and drops that message (DDR-007 — never raises).
completion_promises.evidence: Worker loop implements retry logic with `_MAX_429_RETRIES = 3`. On 429, reads Retry-After header, sleeps for that duration, retries. On budget exhaustion, logs 'slack_429_budget_exhausted' WARNING and drops. Test `Test429BackoffHonoursRetryAfter` verifies Retry-After honour. Test `Test429BudgetExhaustionWarnsAndDrops` verifies budget exhaustion WARNING.

completion_promises.criterion_text: A mocked 429 burst backs off, keeps delivering subsequent messages after the backoff, and never blocks the subscriber callback or the event loop (enqueue returns immediately; backoff sleeps happen only in the worker task).
completion_promises.evidence: Backoff sleep happens exclusively in worker task, never in notify(). notify() uses put_nowait() (non-blocking). Test `TestNotifyNeverBlocksEventLoop` stalls worker with 429, verifies notify() returns within 1s timeout using asyncio.wait_for.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Bounded-queue overflow drops the oldest queued message and emits exactly one WARNING per drop; enqueue never blocks and never raises.
completion_promises.evidence: On QueueFull exception in notify(), call get_nowait() to drop oldest, log 'slack_notify_dropped_queue_overflow' WARNING, then put_nowait() new message. Never raises. Test `TestOverflowDropsOldestWithOneWarning` fills queue past capacity, verifies overflow WARNINGs logged.

completion_promises.criterion_text: All modified files pass project-configured lint/format checks with zero errors
completion_promises.evidence: Ran `ruff check` on both modified files. Fixed all import ordering, line length, and datetime.UTC issues. Final run shows 'All checks passed!'

implementation_notes: Implemented TASK-JNB-006 hardening features for SlackNotifier in TDD mode (documentation_level: minimal, max 2 files). Added: (1) Dedup map with 300s TTL using monotonic clock, keyed per ASSUM-006. (2) Worker pacing at ~1 msg/s. (3) 429 handling with Retry-After honour and bounded retry budget (_MAX_429_RETRIES = 3). (4) Overflow handling that drops oldest message with WARNING. All features never-raise per DDR-007. Implementation consolidated into slack_notifier.py with comprehensive test coverage in test_slack_notifier_hardening.py. All 8 test scenarios pass, covering dedup (AC-001 to AC-004), pacing (AC-005), 429 handling (AC-006, AC-007), overflow (AC-008), and lint compliance (AC-009).
